name: Noir City Tote
tagline: A structured everyday tote with quiet city polish.
description: Cut from smooth full-grain leather, the Noir City Tote holds a laptop, a book, and the rest of a working day without losing its line. The silhouette is architectural, the hardware is unlacquered brass, and the interior is split so keys never vanish into the same pocket as papers.
materials: Full-grain Italian leather, cotton twill lining, brass hardware
strap: Dual top handles with an optional 110 cm shoulder strap

name: Cognac Work Tote
tagline: Warm leather that only looks better after a season of use.
description: Helen’s studio favorite. The Cognac Work Tote is built for commutes and long lunches: a padded 15-inch sleeve, a zip pocket for documents, and a leather that deepens as it wears. We dye it in small batches so no two hides share the exact same glow.
materials: Vegetable-tanned cowhide, suede-lined laptop sleeve, antique brass

name: Ivory Quilted Shoulder
tagline: Soft quilting, a pale hide, and an evening-ready line.
description: A lighter leather, diamond-quilted by hand and finished with a turn-lock that clicks closed rather than snaps. The Ivory Quilted Shoulder is meant for dinners, galleries, and any hour you want the bag to feel like part of the outfit instead of an afterthought.
materials: Nappa leather, silk-blend lining, gold-tone hardware

name: Crimson Mini Quilt
tagline: A small bag in a color that does the talking.
description: The Crimson Mini Quilt is sized for a phone, a card case, and lipstick — nothing more, on purpose. The hide is aniline-dyed so the red stays rich in daylight and candlelight alike. A magnetic flap keeps the silhouette clean.
materials: Aniline-dyed lambskin, microfiber lining, gold-tone hardware

name: Sage Compact Crossbody
tagline: Hands-free, quietly colored, built for all-day wear.
description: A compact crossbody in a muted sage that sits easily against linen, denim, and black. The strap is wide enough to stay put, the flap is lined in suede, and the front pocket is cut for a transit card you can reach without opening the bag.
materials: Pebbled calfskin, suede flap lining, nickel hardware

name: Navy Commuter Backpack
tagline: A city backpack that still reads as considered.
description: Navy canvas with leather trim, a padded back panel, and a sleeve that slides over a suitcase handle. We make the Commuter for people who walk more than they drive: weather-resistant cloth, a hidden zip at the top, and straps that do not bite.
materials: Waxed cotton canvas, vegetable-tanned trim, YKK hardware
strap: Padded shoulder straps with a sternum clip

name: Camel Saddle Bag
tagline: A classic saddle shape in sun-warmed leather.
description: The Camel Saddle Bag sits at the hip with a flap that folds like a letter. The leather is pulled-up so scuffs become part of the surface rather than damage. Inside: one zip pocket, two slip pockets, and enough room for a compact umbrella.
materials: Pulled-up cowhide, cotton lining, darkened brass

name: Forest Weekender
tagline: Two nights away, packed with room to spare.
description: A generous holdall in forest-green leather, structured enough to stand on its own and soft enough to crush into an overhead locker. The base is reinforced, the zip is two-way, and a trolley sleeve keeps it stacked on a larger case.
materials: Corrected-grain leather, canvas lining, antique brass zip
strap: Rolled handles and a detachable shoulder strap

name: Blush Mini Hobo
tagline: A slouch of pale pink leather for lighter days.
description: The Blush Mini Hobo is gathered at the top so it slumps just enough. The leather is a pale rose that reads as pink in sunlight and almost nude under indoor light. A magnetic snap hides in the gather — no hardware shouting from the front.
materials: Soft nappa, micro suede lining, hidden magnet

name: Espresso Satchel
tagline: A dark satchel with a lock, a flap, and a serious interior.
description: Espresso leather, a belted flap, and a lock that is decorative until you decide it is not. The satchel is the bag we recommend for anyone carrying a notebook they care about: rigid sides, a pen loop, and a base that does not sag on a café table.
materials: Drum-dyed cowhide, suede lining, brass lock

name: Sand Canvas Tote
tagline: A lighter tote for markets, libraries, and weekends.
description: Heavy sand canvas with leather handles and a snap-close inner pouch. It is the least precious bag we make, on purpose — washable lining, a wide mouth, and a price that invites daily use. Still inspected twice, still stitched in the same studio.
materials: 12 oz cotton canvas, vegetable-tanned handles, snap pouch

name: Bordeaux Crossbody
tagline: Wine-dark leather for evenings that run long.
description: A slim crossbody in bordeaux calf, cut close to the body. The front panel is unadorned; the color is the ornament. Inside, a zip divide keeps coins from mixing with keys. Wear it high for dinner or lengthen the strap for walking home.
